items.title: Your first day at a new job or college
items.prompt: Describe your first day at a new job or college. Take us back to one moment from that day.

items.title: Sum up a movie or show in three sentences
items.prompt: Pick a movie or show you've watched recently. Summarize it in three sentences for someone deciding whether to watch it.

items.title: Repeat back a tricky request
items.prompt: Your teammate says: “I need the numbers by Thursday, but only the regional ones, and in the old format, not the new one.” Confirm what they need.

items.title: Pitch a school carpool to your neighbors
items.prompt: Convince two neighbors to start a carpool for school drop-off.

items.title: Recap a meeting in 30 seconds
items.prompt: Your colleague missed today's meeting and asks what happened. Give them the recap.

items.title: Explain your job at Thanksgiving dinner
items.prompt: At Thanksgiving dinner, your uncle asks what you actually do all day. Explain it so the whole table gets it.

items.title: Open a cold call in 20 seconds
items.prompt: You're calling a small business owner you've never spoken to about your service. Open the call.
